lastText: The Case Is ClosedThe Hound LooseNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 56THE MERRIPIT NATURALIST: STILL NOT FOUNDThe man who called himself Stapleton is never found. A constable thinks that he has been seen at Plymouth, and a clerk thinks that he has been seen at Southampton, and a magistrate in Hull says that he has seen him in a hat. The wife goes to her relations. The Hall is shut. A year later a farmer on the moor finds the skeleton of a large dog in the heather, and a ring of white wands going out into the Mire.
